The transcription's note places the sketch in the right margin; it is at the lower left of the page. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): laid over the scan rendered at 350 dpi in colour, whole and zoomed (19 px a unit); not compiled (no TeX engine in the session), the TikZ was rasterised by a script. The q-axis, the oblique line, their crosses and the labels phi(x), phi(x)+1 lie on their ink within about 1 unit. The overwritten first label stays left out, as the transcription has it (« une étiquette surchargée »).

Lower part: a heavy vertical stroke gone over several times, with a bar under the first formula, a short bar in the middle and a heavy bar at the foot; the four formulas written beside it are set from the transcription's marginal note, at their places. Still differs: the stroke is drawn as one heavy line; the bar under the first formula is a brace on the page. Left out: the formulas below the scale and the long brace at the left of the column. Not mentioned in the transcription's notes as a figure. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): re-read on millimetre grids of the scan rendered at 350 dpi in colour (12 px a unit); not compiled (no TeX engine in the session), the TikZ was rasterised by a script and laid over the crop; every stroke now lies on its ink within about 1 unit. Changed: the upper axis and its dot moved 1.5 units left onto their ink, the bar at its foot follows its slight curve, d' moved 2 units onto its place; the long lower stroke is drawn as the heavy stroke and the two thinner strokes that go over it; under the first formula the bar is drawn as the bracket it is (both ends turned up); the curved stroke under (d-d'+1), with its right end turned up, is added (it was missing); the middle bar follows its curve; the heavy foot is two strokes. The three formulas beside the column moved onto their places (up to 7 units). Left out as before: the formulas below the scale (text) and the long brace at the left of the marginal column (layout of the margin, not named by the mark).

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, deux croquis au crayon : un cube esquissé, repassé de plusieurs traits intérieurs, et au-dessous un parallélogramme partagé par un trait
drawings.notes: Pencil. The parallelogram: four sides, the lower one heavier, and a stroke across it. The cube: redrawn stroke by stroke (front top edge, left and bottom edges, back top edge, right edge, two receding edges, inner verticals, a short horizontal and two short obliques at the bottom). Still differs: the cube is a loose sketch whose inner strokes (a subdivision or hidden edges) are a reading; the strokes do not close up on the page and are not closed here. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): both sketches redrawn stroke by stroke on millimetre grids of the scan rendered at 350 dpi in colour (12-16 px a unit), as their strokes were 1 to 4 units off; not compiled (no TeX engine in the session), the TikZ was rasterised by a script and laid over the crop; every stroke now lies on its ink within about 1 unit. The cube is seventeen strokes, none closed up: back and front top edges (the front one heavier), the oblique edges at the upper left, upper right and lower right, the left and far right sides (the far right one curved), the long inner stroke from the front top edge down to the bottom, the inner left vertical, two short strokes at the top centre (a « 1 »-like stroke), a short vertical and a horizontal in the lower right, the front right edge, the bottom edge, a thin oblique at the lower left and a heavier one rising from the foot of the long inner stroke. The parallelogram: its left side stops short of the top edge, which starts with a small curve; the lower side heavier, ending in a blot; the stroke across it. Which strokes are hidden edges or a subdivision is a matter of reading: they are drawn as they are.
